servicesIndex.label: SERVICES
servicesIndex.title: What we build.
servicesIndex.body: Six capabilities spanning web, AI, automation, SaaS, landing experiences and full digital products — one continuum from idea to production.

web-applications.title: Web Applications
web-applications.tagline: Modern web applications built for performance, scalability and real users.
web-applications.problem: Products stall when the foundation can't scale, stay secure, or stay fast under real traffic.
web-applications.whatWeBuild: End-to-end web applications — from interface to API to cloud — designed for production from day one.

faq.a: Yes — we modernize in phases so you keep shipping while the stack improves.

faq.q: Can you work with an existing design system?
faq.a: We can adopt yours or establish a lean system that matches Ginvify-level craft.

ai-engineering.title: AI Engineering
ai-engineering.tagline: AI that doesn't just answer. It acts.
ai-engineering.problem: Most AI demos stop at chat. Production needs retrieval, tools, evaluation and safe action.
ai-engineering.whatWeBuild: Intelligent systems — RAG, agents, vision and APIs — wired into real product workflows.

faq.a: When needed — otherwise we prefer strong foundation models plus retrieval and fine-tuning where it pays off.

automation.title: Automation
automation.tagline: Turn repetitive work into intelligent systems.
automation.problem: Manual handoffs between apps drain teams and create fragile, unmeasurable processes.
automation.whatWeBuild: Workflow automation that connects apps, agents and data into reliable business action.

faq.q: Can you connect to our existing tools?
faq.a: Yes — we design around your stack and only introduce new systems when they clearly earn their place.

saas.title: SaaS Platforms
saas.tagline: Design and engineer scalable SaaS products.
saas.problem: SaaS fails quietly when tenancy, billing, auth or data isolation are bolted on late.
saas.whatWeBuild: Multi-tenant platforms with the product, auth, billing and cloud architecture to grow.

faq.q: Do you help with MVP to scale?
faq.a: We design for the path you're on — ship an MVP cleanly, then harden tenancy and ops as you grow.

landing-pages.title: Landing Pages
landing-pages.tagline: Premium interactive landing pages focused on brand, conversion and motion.
landing-pages.problem: Generic pages don't carry a technical brand — or convert sophisticated buyers.
landing-pages.whatWeBuild: Cinematic, high-performance landing experiences with intentional motion and clear CTAs.

faq.a: Yes — when it serves the story. We keep a lighter fallback for mobile and reduced motion.

digital-products.title: Digital Products
digital-products.problem: Ideas stall between discovery, design and engineering without a single accountable path.
digital-products.whatWeBuild: Full product cycles — discovery through MVP, engineering, deployment and optimization.

faq.q: Do you only engineer, or also discover?
faq.a: Both — we can enter at discovery or plug into an existing product team as an engineering partner.

approachHome.body: Three moves that keep products coherent from first sketch to production.

items.title: Discover
items.body: We pressure-test the idea: users, workflows, risks and what “done” actually means.

items.title: Design systems

items.title: Ship & iterate

steps.title: Evolve

faqHome.label: 08B — FAQ
faqHome.title: Questions before we start.
faqHome.body: Straight answers — so you know how we collaborate.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take?
items.a: Web applications, AI systems, automation, SaaS platforms, landing experiences and full digital products — especially where craft and systems thinking both matter.

items.q: When does AI belong in the build?
items.a: When it creates leverage: retrieval, agents, vision or automation inside a real workflow — not as a novelty chat overlay.

items.q: How long does a typical engagement take?
items.a: It depends on scope. We start with a clear brief and architecture slice, then ship in vertical increments you can review.

items.q: Do you work in English and Japanese?
items.a: Yes. The site and collaboration can run in English or Japanese — useful for regional and global teams.
Send a short brief via Contact: goals, constraints, timeline and links. We'll reply with next steps and fit.

items.q: Are the experiments real client work?
items.a: No. Experiments are labeled CONCEPT, EXPERIMENT or PROTOTYPE. We never invent clients, awards or metrics.
